_comment: Tokens allowed to PREFIX a base phrase when generating (variant, base) merge candidates in build_vocabulary. A candidate pair forms only when every prefix token is in this set (unioned with the strip/never-strip token lists from modifier_strip.json) and the remaining tokens exactly equal an existing group's full key — the full-head-phrase rule. Nouns are deliberately absent: 'fish' is not listed, so 'fish sauce' can never pair with 'sauce'; over-restriction is safe (an unpaired variant simply stays its own canonical, preserved by default), over-inclusion risks wrong merges.
